answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 4 graders each stake 51 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. A dune that can be verified, a timber that can be measured, and a violet that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
